title: Broke
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott Paper Company struggles financially while aggressively taking clients from Dunder Mifflin, causing concern among Dunder Mifflin management. Michael and his team face challenges with pricing and delivery costs, leading to tense negotiations with David Wallace and Dunder Mifflin about a potential buyout. Despite financial difficulties and offers, Michael demands to be rehired along with his team and insists on removing Charles, culminating in a deal whose full terms remain uncertain.
